## User story
As a CampusBites student, I want to see the status of my demo food order after checkout.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Mock orders have IDs and four status states.
- [ ] A tracking screen shows the current status.
- [ ] A mock backend API returns status for an order ID.
- [ ] Unknown order IDs show a clear error.
- [ ] Automated tests cover successful and failed lookups.
- [ ] A human checks the diff before merging AI-generated changes.

See `docs/STUDENT_CHALLENGE.md` for detailed requirements. Never commit model API keys.
